ImageDescription.value:
Russian imperial family (Nicholas II, Alexandra Fyodorovna, OTMA Olga-Tatiana-Maria-Anastasia Nikolaevna Romanova) and Nikolai Sablin with common people at a wooden bridge near Mogilev, September 1916.
Source: Anastasia album 1916-1917, photo n° 290.
